source: Chapter 676: You Intisians
target: Capitulum 676: Vos, Intisiani

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpret: CKtalon

source: Camus was stunned to find Amandina here.
target: Camus obstupefactus est, cum Amandinam hic invenit.

source: His astonishment far outweighed any joy he might have felt.
target: Eius stupor longe superabat omne gaudium, quod sentire poterat.

source: From the window above, Amandina noticed the four figures below.
target: Ex fenestra superiori, Amandina quattuor figuras deorsum animadvertit.

source: Her face twisted in alarm, and she disappeared into the house’s shadowy interior.
target: Vultus eius in metu contortus est, et in obscuram interiorem domus evanuit.

source: Taken aback, Camus called out, “Don’t be scared! We’re here to keep you safe!”
target: Perturbatus, Camus exclamat: “Noli timere! Adsumus ut te tueamur!”

source: While shouting, he raced up the stairs to the second floor of Twanaku’s residence.
target: Clamans, scalas celeriter ascendit ad secundum tabulatum in domo Twanaku.

source: His visit to Palm Manor had confirmed Louis Berry’s theory.
target: Visitatio eius Palm Manor confirmavit theoriam Ludovici Berry.

source: The Dream Festival participants had lost control of their actions, driven by hidden malevolence and desires.
target: Participes Festi Somniorum, impulsī ex occultā malitiā et cupiditatibus, imperium actuum suorum amiserunt.

source: Yet, their minds remained lucid, allowing for communication.
target: Attamen mentes eorum lucidae manebant, permittens colloquia.

source: Camus couldn’t be sure if the possessed individuals would misinterpret others’ words.
target: Camus certus esse non potuit an possessi homines verba aliorum maliter interpretarent.

source: Furthermore, this wasn’t true clarity of thought.
target: Praeterea, hoc non erat vera claritas cogitandi.

source: They wouldn’t realize they were dreaming, and the experience would fade upon waking.
target: Non noverent se somniare, et experientia cum evigilaverint evanescet.

source: Thump! Thump! ‘Thump! Camus and Rhea charged into the building, taking the steps two at a time.
target: Tum! Tum! Tum! Camus et Rhea in aedificium impetum fecerunt, gradus duos simul petentes.

source: Behind the house, out of sight, a glass window set in wooden planks swung open.
target: Post domum, extra conspectum, fenestra vitrea in tabulis ligneis posita oscillans aperiebatur.

source: Amandina, clad in black hunting gear, nimbly climbed out.
target: Amandina, induta vestimenta venatoria nigris, celeriter e fenestra evasit.

source: She used the wall’s protrusions and crevices to swiftly descend to the ground.
target: Uti murorum protuberantiis et fissuris, celeriter in terram descendit.

source: As her feet touched the earth, she noticed a figure watching her from the side.
target: Cum pedes eius terram tetigerent, animadvertit figuram ex latere eam spectantem.

source: It was Lugano, his right arm ending in a bloody stump, his face marred with crimson stains.
target: Erat Lugano, cuius dextrum brachium in truncum cruentum confectum erat, cuius facies cruentibus maculis lacerata erat.

source: He looked a frightful mess.
target: Videbatur terribilis.

source: Amandina’s heart clenched.
target: Cor Amandinae contraxit.

source: She pressed her back against a pillar supporting Twanaku’s house, fists tightening as she shut her eyes.
target: Dorsum suum columnae, quae domum Twanaku sustinebat, apposuit, et manibus stringens oculos clausit.

source: In the same instant, Lugano’s eyelids drooped, his mind growing hazy.
target: In eodem momento, palpebra Lugani deflexerunt, et mens eius obscurata est.

source: He collapsed to the ground, falling into a deep sleep where he lay.
target: In terram corruit, cadens in profundum somnum, in quo iacebat.

source: Amandina’s eyes snapped open, no longer using her power to force the battle-worn man into slumber.
target: Oculi Amandinae subito aperti sunt, neque iam vim suam ad virum certaminis laniatum in somnum coegendum adhibuit.

source: Doing so would trap her in a profound sleep, able to act only in her Nightmare form, her body immobile.
target: Id faciens eam in profundo somno inclusam teneret, ita ut solum in forma somniorum terribilium agere posset, dum corpus eius immobilis remaneret.

source: And the man wasn’t alone!
target: Et vir non solus erat!

source: Before Lugano could wake naturally, Amandina turned to flee, seeking a safe haven to conceal herself.
target: Antequam Lugano naturaliter evigilaret, Amandina fugere conversa est, quaerens refugium tutum ad se celandum.

source: At that moment, she heard a smirking voice.
target: In illo momento, vocem subridientem audivit.

source: “So you’re a Beyonder too.”
target: Ergo etiam tu Beyonder es.

source: Amandina instinctively glanced over and saw the adventurer, Louis Berry, standing before another wooden pillar supporting Twanaku’s house, not far from her.
target: Amandina instinctive suspicata, vidit Ludovicum Berry, adventatorem, stantem coram aliam columnam ligneam, quae domum Twanaku fovebat, non longe ab ea.

source: The handsome Louis Berry, with his dark hair and emerald eyes, had one hand in his pocket as he leaned against the pillar.
target: Pulcher Ludovicus Berry, cum capillis atris et oculis smaragdineis, manum unam in sinu habebat, dum ad columnam se inclinabat.

source: His feet were crossed behind him, and his lips curled into a playful smile as he looked her way.
target: Pedes eius post se transversi erant, et labia eius in risu iucundo incurvata erant, dum eam aspiceret.

source: The dim crimson moonlight of the night lent him an air of enigmatic and sinister allure.
target: Lunae lumen rubrum tenue noctis ei dedit aerem enigmaticum atque sinistrum.

source: Amandina tightened her fists once more and closed her eyes.
target: Amandina iterum pugnos contraxit atque oculos clausit.

source: However, her spiritual senses told her that Louis Berry had vanished in an instant.
target: Attamen sensus spirituales eius indicaverunt ei, quod Ludovicus Berry in momento evanuerat.

source: She couldn’t find the target and couldn’t use her corresponding abilities.
target: Non potuit destinatum invenire neque facultates congruentes adhibere.

source: Moments later, Amandina, with her heightened spiritual perception, cast her gaze towards the shadows on the ground floor of the house.
target: Momento post, Amandina, cum perceptione spirituali aucta, oculos suos in umbras in plano terraneo domus intendit.

source: She sensed something stirring there.
target: Aliquid ibi agitare sensit.

source: At the same time, Amandina heard an illusory and ethereal voice.
target: Eodem tempore, Amandina vocem illusoriam et aethericam audivit.

source: “We mean you no harm.
target: “Non tibi nocere intendimus.

source: “We’re not affected by the Dream Festival.”
target: Festi Somniorum non nos afficit.”

source: Amandina, who was about to use her spiritual perception to lock onto the formless presence in the shadow, was taken aback.
target: Amandina, quae perceptionem spiritualem ad entitatem sine forma in umbra captandam uti vellebat, obstupefacta est.

source: Just then, Camus and Rhea ran to the corresponding window and called out to Amandina,
target: Statim Camus et Rhea ad eandem fenestram cucurrerunt et Amandinae vocaverunt,

source: “We’re here to protect you!”
target: “Adsumus ut te protegamus!”

source: “We have enough self-control.”
target: “Satis nobis est moderatio.”

source: After assessing the number and strength of the two sides, Amandina asked skeptically, “Why aren’t you affected?”
target: Postquam numerum et potentiam utriusque partis aestimaverat, Amandina sceptice rogavit: “Cur non afficimini?”

source: As she spoke, she locked onto the formless entity in the shadow, believing it to be the strongest among the opposing group—the adventurer, Louis Berry.
target: Dum loquebatur, arripuit entitatem in umbra sine forma, credens eam potentissimam esse inter adversarios, id est adventatorem Ludovicum Berry.

source: If she discovered anything amiss and something went awry, controlling Louis Berry first would effectively increase her chances of escape.
target: Si quid inordinatum inveniret et aliquid male eveniret, primum Ludovicum Berry moderare casus eius evadendi efficaciter augeret.

source: Lumian’s body emerged from the shadows.
target: Corpus Lumiani ex umbris emersit.

source: He glanced at Lugano, who had regained consciousness and stood up, and inwardly praised Amandina’s keen spiritual perception.
target: Animadvertit ad Luganon, qui conscientiam recepit et surrexit, et intime acutam Amandinae perceptionem spiritualem laudavit.

source: Then, he smiled at Amandina and said, “Surely you’ve noticed that we’ve been entering and exiting this house frequently over the past few days?”
target: Tum Amandinae subridens dixit: “Certe animadvertisti nos hanc domum per hos dies saepe intrasse et egressos esse?”

source: “What about you? How are you able to maintain your normal self-control?”
target: “Quid de te? Quomodo tuam normalem sui moderationem conservas?”

source: Amandina glanced at the house beside her, no longer puzzled by Lumian and the others’ ability to remain lucid and rational.
target: Amandina domum iuxta se aspexit, iam non admirata de potestate Lumiani et aliorum lucide ac rationabiliter manendi.

source: She pursed her lips and said, “Robert took me on a date to Twanaku’s place. I spent half the night here.”
target: Labris contrictis, dixit: “Robert me ad domum Twanaku duxit, et hic dimidiam noctem egit.”

source: Camus’s heart ached as he blurted out, “Robert knows what’s special about this place?”
target: Cor Camusi dolevit, dum exclamavit: “Robert novit quid hoc loco speciale sit?”

source: Amandina nodded nimbly.
target: Amandina celeriter annuit.

source: “He knows the Dream Festival very well.”
target: “Festum Somniorum eum valde bene novit.”

source: “What’s his relationship with Twanaku?” Lumian asked thoughtfully.
target: “Quae est eius relatio cum Twanaku?” inquit Lumian, meditabunde.

source: Amandina pondered for a moment.
target: Amandina per momentum meditavit.

source: “I don’t know. At the very least, I haven’t noticed any romantic tension between them or any interactions.”
target: “Nescio. Saltem inter eos nullam tensionem romanticam aut interactiones animadverti.”

source: What do you mean by romantic tension? Lumian didn’t directly inquire about Mr. Robert’s knowledge of the Dream Festival. Instead, he asked something else.
target: “Quid significat ‘tensionem romanticam’?”—Lumian directe de scientia Domini Robert de Festum Somniorum non interrogavit. Proinde aliquid aliud rogavit.

source: “Are you a Beyonder of the Evernight pathway?”
target: “Esne Beyonder via Noctis Aeternae?”

source: Amandina blinked and hesitantly said, “In a way…”
target: Amandina micavit et dubiter inquit: “Quodammodo…”

source: Upstairs, Camus inquired with concern, “Where did you obtain the potion formula and the corresponding ingredients?”
target: In plano superiore, Camus sollicite rogavit: “Unde obtinuisti formulam potionis et ingredienta congruentia?”

source: As they conversed, various movements and shouts echoed from the plantations outside the town and throughout the town.
target: Dum colloquebantur, varia motus et clamores e agris extra oppidum et per totum oppidum resonabant.

source: Amandina’s eyes darted around as she grinned and said, “Can I choose not to answer?”
target: Amandina oculos circumspiciens, ridens dixit: “Possumne eligere non respondere?”

source: “What do you think?” Lumian smiled at her.
target: “Quid putas?” inquit Lumian, ad eam subridens.

source: Amandina didn’t back down. She raised her head slightly and stared into Lumian’s eyes without flinching.
target: Amandina non recedebat. Paululum caput elevavit et in oculos Lumiani fixiter intuens manebat.

source: She noticed that his smile remained unchanged, and his emerald-green yet deep eyes remained emotionless.
target: Animadvertit risus eius immutatus esse, et oculi eius virides smaragdineos, at profundi, sine affectu remansisse.

source: After more than ten seconds, Amandina averted her gaze and tilted her head slightly.
target: Post plus quam decem secundis, Amandina oculos avertit et paululum caput inclinavit.

source: “I obtained it in this dream.”
target: “Hanc in hoc somnio obtinui.”

source: Camus, who was on the third floor, was taken aback. “You obtained it during the Dream Festival?”
target: Camus, qui in tertio tabulato erat, obstupefactus est: “Hanc obtinuisti tempore Festi Somniorum?”

source: He could understand obtaining a potion formula during the Dream Festival. While knowledge gains could be replicated in reality, could Beyonder ingredients used to concoct potions be brought from the dream to reality?
target: Intelligere poterat formulam potionis tempore Festi Somniorum obtinuisse. Cum scientiae augmenta in re replicari possent, num ingredientia Beyonder, ad potiones concoquendas adhibita, ex somnio in rem transferi possent?

source: Could it be that after consuming a potion during the Dream Festival, one could also remain a Beyonder upon waking?
target: Num fieri posset ut, post potionem tempore Festi Somniorum consumptam, quis etiam Beyonder post evigilationem maneret?

source: This subverted much of mysticism’s common sense!
target: Hoc multum sensus communis mysticismi subvertit!

source: Without waiting for Amandina’s confirmation, Camus thought of a possibility.
target: Sine confirmationem Amandinae exspectans, Camus de possibilitate cogitavit.

source: He immediately asked Amandina, “Are you a Beyonder only in this dream?”
target: Statim Amandinae rogavit: “Esne Beyonder tantum in hoc somnio?”

source: Amandina wanted to play dumb, but after glancing at Louis Berry, who was looking at her with a faint smile, she said gloomily, “It’s the same in reality, but I don’t have many chances to showcase it.”
target: Amandina stultam se agere voluit, sed post prospectum Ludovici Berry, qui eam leviter subridente aspiciebat, tristiter dixit: “Idem est in re, sed pauca mihi sunt occasiones ut id exhibeam.”

source: How is this possible? Camus gazed down at Amandina, suspecting that the mystical knowledge he had encountered since childhood was inaccurate.
target: Quomodo hoc fieri potest? Camus in Amandinam deorsum intuens suspicatus est, quod scientas mystica, ab infantia percepta, esse erronea.

source: He had considered the possibility that Amandina was lying, but he wasn’t willing to doubt this girl who held a special place in his heart.
target: Possibilitatem consideraverat Amandinam mentiri, sed non voluit haec puella, quae locum specialem in corde eius occupabat, dubitare.

source: At that moment, Lumian spoke calmly to Amandina, his expression unperturbed, “You haven’t consumed a potion, have you?”
target: Illo momento, Lumian Amandinae tranquillime locutus est, vultu inmutato, “Non potuisti potionem consumere, nonne?”

source: Amandina’s expression shifted slightly. She puffed up her cheeks and muttered, “Why are you still asking me if you already know…”
target: Vultus Amandinae leviter mutatus est. Genas inflavit et submurmuravit: “Cur adhuc me interrogas, si iam scis…”

source: “Haven’t consumed a potion?” Camus, Rhea, and Lugano were taken aback, but as they recalled their encounters, they gained a better understanding of Amandina’s situation.
target: “Non potionem consumpsit?” Camus, Rhea, et Lugano obstupefacti erant, sed, recollectis suis congressionibus, melius de Amandinae condicione intellexerunt.

source: “It’s indeed a boon, but I’m not sure how it was accomplished…” Lumian silently smiled as Camus nervously asked Amandina, “Which evil god deceived you?”
target: “Vere beneficium est, sed nescio quomodo id confectum sit…” Lumian tacite subridens, dum Camus anxius Amandina interrogavit, “Qui deus malus te decipuit?”

source: Amandina was bewildered. “Evil god? What evil god?”
target: Amandina confusa est. “Deus malus? Quid deus malus?”

source: Before Camus could explain, Lumian asked thoughtfully,
target: Antequam Camus explicare posset, Lumian cogitans rogavit:

source: “How did you obtain these supernatural abilities?”
target: “Quomodo has facultates supernaturales obtinuisti?”

source: Amandina scoffed.
target: Amandina irriduit.

source: “Why should I tell you?”
target: “Cur tibi dicam?”

source: In the next moment, she saw Louis Berry reveal a smile that inexplicably terrified her.
target: In proximo momento, vidit Ludovicum Berry subridens, cuius risus inexplicabiliter eam terruit.

source: “It’s—it’s Robert,” Amandina said with a shiver. “He took me into the forest outside and led me to a huge black stone. He asked me to place my hand on it.”
target: “Est—est Robert,” Amandina, tremens, dixit. “Me in silvam extra duxit et ad magnam lapidem nigrum perduxit; imperavit ut manum super illud ponerem.”

source: “And then you became a Beyonder?” Lugano interrupted Amandina with surprise and curiosity, failing to abide by his duty as a servant.
target: “Et tum facta es Beyonder?” interpellavit Lugano Amandinam, stupore et curiositate affectus, officium servilis non observans.

source: Amandina shook her head.
target: Amandina caput quassavit.

source: “Then I fell asleep—in the dream. When I woke up, I had superpowers.”
target: “Tum obdormivi—in somnio. Cum evigilavi, facultates supernaturales habui.”

source: “Is Robert also a Beyonder? Did he obtain his powers through the same method?” Camus pressed.
target: “Estne etiam Robert Beyonder? Eadem via facultates suas adeptus est?” Camus percontatus est.

source: Amandina let out a soft sigh and said, “He’s a Beyonder, but I don’t know if he obtained his abilities the same way. He brought me on a date here. Before entering this dream, he was already a Beyonder.”
target: Amandina leniter suspiravit et dixit: “Robert Beyonder est, sed nescio utrum eadem via facultates suas adeptus sit. Me hic ad colloquium duxit; antequam in hoc somnio intraret, iam Beyonder erat.”

source: Biack boulder… Lumian emerged from the ground floor of Hisoka’s house and asked Amandina with a smile, “Where’s Robert? He’s not having a date with you here?”
target: “Biack boulder…” Lumian ex plano terraneo domus Hisoka emergens Amandinae subridens rogavit: “Ubi est Robert? Nonne hic tecum colloquium habet?”

source: Amandina’s expression shifted between anger and amusement as she replied, “He wanted to visit his other lover before coming to me.”
target: Vultus Amandinae inter iram et laetitiam mutatus est, cum respondit: “Voluit alteram amantem suam visitare, antequam ad me veniret.”

source: “He has another lover? Who?” Camus asked, suddenly angry.
target: “Habetne alteram amantem? Qui?” inquit Camus, subito iratus.

source: Amandina’s eyes darted around, and she hesitated for a moment with a strange expression.
target: Amandina oculos circumspiciens, et paulisper, vultu insolito, dubitavit.

source: “Padre Cali.”
target: “Padre Cali.”

source: “Uh…”
target: “Eh…”

source: “Huh?” Camus, Rhea, and Lugano couldn’t help but exclaim in shock and confusion.
target: “Heu?” Camus, Rhea, et Lugano, stupefacti et confusi, exclamaverunt.

source: Even someone as well-read as Lumian couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows.
target: Etiam Lumian, tam eruditus, supercilia levare non potuit.

source: Amandina spread her hands and said, “He does like women, but he prefers men.”
target: Amandina manus explicavit et dixit: “Mulieres amat, sed viros praeferit.”

source: “He said he brought me into the dream to obtain superpowers because he felt guilty towards me. He was also grateful that I was willing to help him keep it a secret and not break off the engagement, continuing to go out with him, make out with him, protecting his image even after knowing his other side.”
target: “Dixit se me in somnium duxisse ad facultates supernaturales obtinendas, quod culpa erga me eum opprimeret. Etiam gratias egit quod parata essem ei auxilium ferre, ut arcana retineret nec pactum dissolveret, sed cum eo pergere, eum osculari, eius imaginem protegere, etiam postquam alteram eius partem cognovisset.”

source: At that moment, Camus and Rhea remained silent, but Lumian sensed the same meaning in their eyes.
target: Eo tempore Camus et Rhea silentiam retinuere, sed Lumian in oculis eorum eundem sensum sentivit.

source: You Intisians…
target: Vos, Intisiani…

source: Amused, Lumian asked Amandina, “And you can accept that?”
target: Oblectatus, Lumian Amandinae rogavit: “Et id accipere potes?”

source: Amandina pondered seriously. “Why not? As a marriage partner, Robert excels in status, wealth, strength, looks, and skills. In the Southern Continent, there aren’t many better choices. Besides, we did have a beautiful relationship. He does love me, but he also loves Padre Cali.”
target: Amandina serio meditata est: “Cur non? Ut coniunx, Robert in dignitate, opibus, fortitudine, specie, et peritia praevalet. In Continente Meridionali non sunt multae optimae electiones. Praeterea, pulchram relationem habuimus. Me amat, sed etiam Padre Cali amat.”

source: Amandina smiled at Lumian and said, “He also promised me more freedom.”
target: Amandina Lumiani subridens dixit: “Praeterea mihi maiorem libertatem promisit.”

source: Upon hearing Amandina’s response and looking at the youthful and beautiful girl, Camus, who was on the third floor, suddenly felt a pang of sorrow.
target: Responsum Amandinae audito et puellam iuvenem ac pulchram observans, Camus, qui in tertio tabulato versabatur, subito dolorem sensit.

source: A certain beauty in his heart shattered.
target: Quidam decus in corde eius fractus est.

source: Lumian glanced up at him and scoffed inwardly.
target: Lumian in eum respexit et interiora risu subridens.

source: Hadn’t he been mentally prepared to see the other side of Amandina? Amandina managed to express herself succinctly in a very self-controlled manner without demonstrating it.
target: Num non iam praeparatus fuisset ad alteram Amandinae partem videndam? Amandina se breviter, et valde temperate, expressit, sine manifestando id.

source: Perhaps Amandina had deliberately said so much in front of Camus to prevent him from loving her out of pity.
target: Fortasse Amandina coram Camus deliberate tantum dixerat, ut eum, propter pietatem, eam amare prohiberet.

source: Lumian turned to Amandina.
target: Lumian ad Amandinam se vertit.

source: “In other words, Robert is currently in Saint-Sien Cathedral?”
target: “Alio modo, Robert nunc in Cathedrali Saint-Sien est?”

source: “Yes.” Amandina nodded.
target: “Ita.” Amandina annuit.

source: Lumian tersely acknowledged her words and spoke in a commanding tone, “Then let’s pay him and Padre Cali a ‘visit..’”
target: Lumian breviter verba eius agnovit et voce imperativa locutus est, “Ergo visitemus eum et Padre Cali.”
